items.title: The Hornets say Kon Knueppel suffered a left hamstring injury and Grant Williams suffered a right hamstring injury during offseason on-court activity.
items.author: J.E. Skeets
items.body_excerpt:
The Hornets say Kon Knueppel suffered a left hamstring injury and Grant Williams suffered a right hamstring injury during offseason on-court activity. 

Wild timing. 

I talked to Grant earlier this week — the podcast drops tomorrow — and he was excited to enter this season healthy. 😔
